note: Alberta Parks recreation area beside Kehiwin Lake, 28 km east of St. Paul on Hwy 29 and 7 km north on Hwy 41, operated by the Kehiwin Cree Nation: two rows of treed sites strung along the shore lane (1-20 at the north end, 21-33 to the south), with a boat launch, pier and fish-cleaning stand between them. No firewood sold. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Apr 23, 2026) and the campground guide: 33 unserviced first-come sites C$28, season Jun 3 - Sep 7 (manual, matches), vault toilets, no drinking water, boat launch/pier/fish cleaning. Lakefront -> lakeview recommended (trees and a shoreline fringe between pads and water). Phone and pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - recommend lakeview): the campground guide map puts sites 21-33 (south row) on the west side of a lane running behind a continuous belt of trees; on imagery that row is ~30-50 m from open water through the tree belt and a band of aquatic vegetation, so not on-water. Sites 10-20 (the lake side of the north lane) are ~15-30 m from the water among scattered trees and grassy openings, with a dark shoreline fringe (reeds or shrub) at the edge; the brochure says 'basic campsites with nice trees and bush for privacy'. I could not confirm open ground from any pad to the water, so the gate is not met on the evidence; the alternative, if the reviewer reads the north row as open, is lakefront with a caveat naming sites 10-20. The stored evidence's 'open grass apron between the shore road and Kehiwin Lake' at 54.036,-110.904 matches the day-use/boat-launch clearing between the two rows, not a campsite row.

PHONE (stored 780-815-1214): the page's Information line is '1-833-534-3946; 780-815-1214' (Leaseholder: Kehiwin Cree Nation); stored number is the second of these - OK. The 2021 brochure's 'Park Information Phone: 780-594-7856' is older.
SEASON: page 'Season: Jun 3 - Sep 7', current status 'Seasonal Closure' - matches the manual season. No winter camping. FCFS, so not on the shop (no 2027 'Closed through' date).

PIN (54.03583,-110.90440): between the two site rows near the day-use area, ~200 m from each row's centre (north row ~54.0389,-110.9041, south row ~54.0348,-110.9052) and ~235 m from the page's directions point 54.037927,-110.904045 - within tolerance for a 600 m-long strip; no move.
SENIORS LINE: absent. ADVISORIES: none. Website OK (camping page, 200).
